dialogues.speaker: Confrontation Duel
dialogues.text: (Fischl and Sucrose are playing Genius Invokation TCG. Maybe it's best not to interrupt their game...)

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: With three Electro Dice, I summon my eternal familiar, Ozvaldo Hrafnavins, to my side. Heed my invokation!

dialogues.speaker: Oz
dialogues.text: But mein Fräulein, I have been by your side all along.

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: I mean in the game, Oz.

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: Hmm... Then I'll use Chaotic Entropy to invoke a Large Wind Spirit...

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: That deals increased damage when it carries an element other than Anemo, so...

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Oh... So be it, one shall not be swayed by such a feeble attack...
